combine_mode_add: Add Supine to the existing animator (beta)
add_target_auto: If left empty, the animator on the avatar's Base layer is used.
add_target_resolved: Target: {0} (taken from the avatar's Base layer)
add_target_vrc_default:
The Base layer of the avatar is empty.
If you continue, Supine will be added to the VRChat SDK default Base animator.
inherit_state_help:
States are picked automatically by name.
Choose another one manually if the names differ.
Leave it empty to keep the Supine default animation.
add_state_help:
States are picked automatically by name.
For the entry state, choose the state used while crouching.
If there is no crouching state, choose the standing one.
Without a prone state, there will be no default prone animation.
add_state_conflict:
There are states that conflict with Supine.
If you continue, the transitions to states other than the chosen prone state will be removed before Supine is added.
add_state_already_combined:
This animator already contains Supine.
If you continue, the existing Supine states and layers will be removed and then added again.
(The standing, crouching and prone states are kept.)
Some unused states may be left behind.
enable_jump_at_desktop: Enable jump motion at desktop mode
check_successful_message:
Check is successful.
Then click Create button to create and place MA Prefab.
check_successful_warning_message:
Check is successful, but there are warnings.
Please check the console log before clicking Create button.
check_failure_message:
Cannot combine.
This is not avatar object.
check_failure_variant_message:
Could not resolve the Supine assets.
The package may be broken.
check_failure_add_target_message:
Could not find the target animator.
Please specify the target animator manually.
check_failure_add_layer_message:
The target animator has no layers.
Please specify another animator.
check_failure_add_entry_message:
No entry state is selected.
Please choose the state that Supine enters from.
ma_prefab_create_failure_message:
Modular Avatar Prefab creation is failure.
Please check the console log.
